verdict.rationale: Google Workspace has a first-party, step-by-step walkthrough for setting up SAML-based SSO with custom apps that are not in the pre-integrated catalog, which covers the core custom-SAML part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows custom OIDC or header-based app support. missing for 10: custom OIDC app configuration, header-based app SSO, independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom SAML flow.
